_readme: Experiment registry (growth directive, Nov 12 2026). Every A/B test in src/data/ab-tests.ts must have a 'live' entry here, and release-checks fails otherwise. Rules: docs/experiments.md. Baselines are only numbers we measured; anything else says 'none yet'. kind 'price' or 'offer' can go live only with ownerOk filled in with Michael's words and date.

experiments.hypothesis: A calmer page with the form on the first phone screen gets more signups per view than the original.
experiments.primaryMetric: newsletter-signup events per ab-view, by variant (Umami), confirmed against Kit subscriber count
guardrails: confirmed subscribers in Kit do not drop
no rise in fake or test signups
experiments.baseline: none yet: Kit had about 10 subscribers Oct 30-Nov 6, many of them Michael's own tests

experiments.hypothesis: A subtle motion background on the homepage hero raises clicks to services and contact without slowing the page.
experiments.primaryMetric: services-cta + contact-click + newsletter-cta per ab-view, by variant (Umami)
guardrails: mobile page weight and load time stay within 10% of control

experiments.hypothesis: Showing the yearly plan's real saving next to the monthly price (same prices, same terms) raises yearly signups without lowering total signups.
experiments.primaryMetric: Stripe checkouts completed per buy-box view, split monthly vs yearly
guardrails: total checkouts per view do not fall
yearly refund requests within 30 days stay at 0-1
experiments.baseline: none yet: 0 customer signups as of Nov 12 2026
experiments.readOn: only after 300 buy-box views per arm; with current traffic that is weeks away

experiments.hypothesis: Email Authentication Setup sells at least as many units per visitor at a higher price than $29, so revenue per visitor rises.
experiments.primaryMetric: revenue per Lockdown page view (Stripe purchases / Umami views), by arm
guardrails: add-on quote requests from Lockdown buyers do not fall
every visitor pays exactly the price shown to them
experiments.baseline: Nov 3-6: 26 paid-search clicks, $43.88 spend, 0 sales at $49 (Google Ads, recorded Nov 7). No sales yet at $29.
experiments.readOn: not before 1,000 page views per arm AND at least 10 purchases in total; until then do not run

experiments.note: Waitlist demand test, not an A/B test, so it has no ab-tests.ts entry. Live from Nov 13 2026, stopped the same day: Michael said skip the waitlist and sell it, so it was replaced by watchdog-paid. Signups taken before then stay in the quiz Worker KV.
experiments.hypothesis: Founders who just checked or fixed their domain will join a waitlist for daily change alerts at a planned $9/mo or $90/yr, enough to justify building Founder Watchdog.
experiments.primaryMetric: qualified waitlist signups (KV wd:entry metadata q=1), plus signups per touchpoint view by 'from' (Umami watchdog-cta, watchdog-view, watchdog-signup)
guardrails: no visitor is charged or promised a beta
Preflight runs and $29 buy-click rate on the touchpoint pages do not fall
unqualified and test signups are reported separately, never counted toward the gate
experiments.baseline: none yet: not shown to visitors as of Nov 13 2026
experiments.readOn: Dec 13 2026 gate (master plan section J: 25+ qualified), and only after at least 100 views of /founders/watchdog/
experiments.ownerOk: Michael, Nov 13 2026: "Ship all items" (waitlist and planned prices on the site, thread: Test demand for Founder Watchdog)

experiments.note: Paid launch, not an A/B test. Founder Watchdog on sale at $9/mo or $90/yr from Nov 13 2026 (Stripe Payment Links, delivered by workers/watchdog).
experiments.hypothesis: Founders who just checked or fixed their domain will pay $9/mo or $90/yr for daily change alerts.
experiments.primaryMetric: paid Watchdog subscriptions (Stripe metadata offer=nk_watchdog), plus buy clicks per touchpoint view by 'from' (Umami watchdog-cta, watchdog-buy)
guardrails: every subscriber gets the TXT setup email and, once verified, a first look (Watchdog KV status and hello@ notices)
refunds and cancels inside 30 days are counted next to sales
Preflight runs and $29 buy-click rate on the touchpoint pages do not fall
experiments.baseline: none yet: first day on sale Nov 13 2026
experiments.readOn: Dec 13 2026 (master plan gate), and only after at least 100 views of /founders/watchdog/
experiments.ownerOk: Michael, Nov 13 2026: "why are we doing a waitlist ... make it live now" (thread: Launch Founder Watchdog as a paid product)
